title: Lesson 4｜双边讨论（五五平衡）
summary: Discuss both views and give your opinion：五五平衡结构，清晰连接，6.5 级模板与练习。

parts.title: 五五平衡结构概览
keypoints: 引言：改写题干 + 提出双方观点 + 明确自己的总体立场
主体一：一方观点（On the one hand ...）→ 解释 → 例子/结果 → 小结（客观评价）
主体二：另一方观点（On the other hand ...）→ 解释 → 例子/结果 → 小结（客观评价）
结论/观点段：重申个人立场与理由（不重复罗列），不引入新论点

parts.title: 6.5 级常用模板/连接
keypoints: 引言：Some people believe/argue that ...; Others claim/suggest that ...; In my opinion, ...
转承：On the one hand / On the other hand；While/Whereas；However/Nevertheless
论证：One reason is that ...；This is because ...；For example, ...；As a result, ...
结论：In conclusion, while ... , I still believe that ...

exercises.title: 引言：改写题干 + 双边引出 + 个人观点
exercises.instruction: 完成常用表达，保持中性客观与清晰立场（6.5 级）。

items.text: university education should focus on job skills,
, both aims are important, but universities should mainly ensure well-rounded learning.

exercises.title: 主体段：观点 A（五五之一）
exercises.instruction: 用 On the one hand 引出；完成主题句、解释、例子与小结词。

items.text: targeted skills can help graduates find jobs more easily.
employers often look for specific abilities.
, practical training can shorten the time needed for new hires.

exercises.title: 主体段：观点 B（五五之二）+ 自己的观点回扣
exercises.instruction: 用 On the other hand 引出；完成解释与例子；句末回扣个人观点。

items.text: broader knowledge helps students think critically and adapt to changes.
, courses in communication and problem-solving benefit different careers.
, a balanced curriculum is more helpful in the long run.

exercises.title: 结论：平衡总结 + 明确立场
exercises.instruction: 不引入新观点；用简洁 6.5 级表达重申立场。

items.text: , while job skills are necessary, I still believe universities should also build wider abilities.

tips.title: 双边引出（引言）
tips.content: Some people argue that ...; Others believe that ...; In my opinion, ...（避免使用过于强烈或生僻的词）

tips.title: 五五平衡的连接
tips.content: On the one hand / On the other hand；While/Whereas；However/Nevertheless（注意语气中性、逻辑平衡）

tips.title: 段内展开（主题→解释→例子→小结）
tips.content: One reason is that ...；This is because ...；For example/For instance ...；As a result ...（句式简洁，条理清楚）

tips.title: 结论（不引入新观点）
tips.content: In conclusion/To sum up, ...；重申立场，避免加入新证据或细节。
